matches.anchor: Sevilla should generate the clearer home scoring pressure against an Osasuna side whose away defensive process and concessions have been vulnerable; Osasuna retain a live single-goal route against a Sevilla defence that has not been fully secure.
matches.counterworld: Sevilla score but do not separate; Osasuna exploit a single scoring route and the match settles at parity.
matches.prime_world: Sevilla’s home creation and the available same-league strength edge press Osasuna back; Osasuna can still score once, but Sevilla reach one or two goals and take control of the result.

matches.anchor: PSG's stronger available strength and sustained chance creation establish the main attacking pressure; Lyon retain a route to one goal but their away attacking process makes repeated away scoring less central.
matches.counterworld: PSG still create enough to score, but their recent defensive exposure allows Lyon to match the home scoring output once or twice and hold a draw.
matches.prime_world: PSG generate the greater volume and quality of attacking pressure, score at least twice in the modal route, and concede at most one Lyon response.
